# COF — Character Open File

> Open container format (.cof, ZIP) for AI characters: identity, personality (Character Card V3 or free text), appearance, identity weights (LoRA), 3D, voice, poses, motion, agent files (skills, a host memory file), and since 1.1 the character's memories as a graph of moments and periods (RFC 0002) and cast fields (gender, archetype, relations — RFC 0003), with rights, organised as elements → variants → presets. Every packed file carries a COF.md that describes it in plain language.

- [Specification (normative, EN)](https://github.com/yannsouetre/cof/blob/main/spec/SPEC.md)
- [Implementer's guide](https://github.com/yannsouetre/cof/blob/main/docs/IMPLEMENTING.md)
- [Agent Skill for authoring .cof files](https://github.com/yannsouetre/cof/blob/main/skills/cof-author/SKILL.md)
- [JSON Schemas](https://github.com/yannsouetre/cof/tree/main/spec/schemas) (published at https://yannsouetre.github.io/cof/schemas/1.1/)
- [RFC 0002 — memories](https://github.com/yannsouetre/cof/blob/main/rfcs/0002-memories.md) · [RFC 0003 — gender, archetype, relations](https://github.com/yannsouetre/cof/blob/main/rfcs/0003-identity-gender-archetype-relations.md)
- [Examples](https://github.com/yannsouetre/cof/tree/main/spec/examples) — 10-clara-mercier is the flagship (bilingual, 12 presets, tags, agent skill); 11-duo-clara-martien shows two characters in one file
- [Reference CLI (validate, pack, extract, merge, export, memory add)](https://github.com/yannsouetre/cof/tree/main/cli) — `pip install cof-cli`; `cof memory add` is the write path for hosts and agents that record a lived memory
- [Builder (browser, no upload)](https://yannsouetre.github.io/cof/builder/)
